scope: Independent finite-allowlist provenance, unchanged baseline semantics, real scanner wrapper canaries and fragment diagnostics. No new full-tree scan.

provenance.missing_preimage_classification: historical source-fingerprint metadata inferred from preserved first-party SHA256 generators and closed before/after/startup context; byte preimages NOT verified, never candidate provenance

baseline_limit: 50 JSON-key mutations were already excluded by baseline allowlists. The new 148 groups preserve all 1134 previously detectable negative cases. Two isolated first-line positives were not detectable at baseline and required whole-file context.

rejected_fallback.decision: Do not allowlist truncated Match/Secret or the 28672-byte scanner context as though it were the full physical line.

constraints: Only two exact file paths and rule generic-api-key
Explicit full RAW source file hash: four reviewed materialized LF/CRLF variants total
StartLine == EndLine == 3081 plus complete physical-line digest from LF split with at most one terminal CR removed
Original source and scanned snapshot bytes stable; do not derive authorization solely from transcoding
Unknown encoding, malformed metadata/path/report, scanner error or any mismatch fails closed
Only the exact findings classified; raw/classified/remaining and original tool exit retained independently
alternative_B_review.reviewed_complete_JSON: Both fixed manifests have 11 build metadata fields and two equal maps of 1688 relative source paths to SHA256 values. Target fingerprints recalculated from public Git blobs. Target line exists twice in before/after maps; position is explicitly fixed.

harness_errata_preserved: First freeze packaging attempt used source_stable instead of the actual sources_stable field and stopped before bundle/MAIN publication; original driver retained.
Initial Git rev-list display-name assertion was too strict after new refs; frozen c28 tree path resolves to the exact existing blob.
An intermediate line-text metadata key collision was fixed before successful review; no source or historical proof changed.
Baseline/verified scalar detected_cases was inflated by defaultdict lookups; immutable rows yield correct counts above. Historical scalars remain untouched.
First digest-template attempt had escaping errors and implicit jsonl format was unsupported; successful v3 output uses explicit --report-format=template.

Line and Match probe drivers initially asserted complete physical Line/full64 Secret for every row. Their failures are the preserved scanner-boundary finding, not accepted green tests. Additive boundary proof categorizes all rows without rewriting earlier outputs.
report_retention: Keep full raw 3026 inventory and triage outside scanned root. A later summary is evidence about its referenced source commit, never a claim that its own new documentation commit was scanned.
